Name: Redesigned Willy
Author: Wererat2000
Description:
My first mod for Stardew Valley, decided to start off with an often overlooked character and added in plenty of options for you to choose from.

Willy has lost his right arm and left leg at some point in his life, and had them replaced with prosthetics years ago

[list=1]
[*]Choose jacket/collared jacket/no jacket
[*]Choose cigar/smoking cigar/no cigar
[*]Choose black prosthetic/robotic hand
[*]Install to your Stardew Valley\Content folder

[/list]
[size=1](The cigar smoke didn't animate as well as I'd like, but I'm sure somebody will like the option.)[/size]

Downloads.Description: Go through the folders choosing your design, then drop into your Stardew Valley/Content folder
